name: Deck Manager
description: The three piles and the shuffle. A deckbuilder's deck is not a list — it is a draw pile, a discard pile, and an exhaust pile with strict rules about how cards move between them, and this component owns those rules and nothing else. The shuffle is seeded and the active seed is exposed, because a run where 'the deck was against me' cannot be replayed is a run whose bad beats cannot be audited; seeded shuffles are also what make daily runs and shared replays possible. Exhaust is its own pile, not deletion, because card text and relics care about the difference. This component does not own what a card does — utility.card_effect_dsl interprets effects — and it does not own the collection the deck was built from: inventory.core_inventory holds every card the player owns outside the run, and the decklist arrives from there.

inputs.name: decklist
inputs.description: Card ids in the deck at run start, dealt from the collection in inventory.core_inventory. Required because a deck manager with no deck is a shuffle with nothing to shuffle.

inputs.name: shuffleSeed
inputs.description: Seed for every pile shuffle. Null means derive one and expose it via lastShuffleSeed — never use unseeded entropy, or replays and daily runs diverge.

inputs.name: handSize
inputs.description: Cards drawn at the start of a turn. Five is the genre's center of gravity: enough for combos, few enough that drawing matters.

inputs.name: reshuffleDiscardOnEmpty
inputs.description: Whether an empty draw pile refreshes from the discard. False is the one-deck rule some board-game chance decks want; inventory.card_draw_deck composes this component and decides per deck.

outputs.name: hand
outputs.description: Card ids currently held, in draw order.

outputs.name: lastShuffleSeed
outputs.description: The seed actually in use, exposed for replay and audit.
